contexts.text: The relation to man in everything of the animal kingdom. Explained.
The relation to man from everything of the vegetable kingdom. Explained.
The relation to man from everything of the mineral kingdom. Explained.
That there is a relation to man of all things of the created universe...
For the general relation of all things is to Him; as the particular relation is to man.
There is provided a conjunction of good and truth through relation. For good is not Known... except by the relation to a less good...
Actors (on the stage) for the sake of relations. Explained.
There is no relation... of good to evil; but there is a relation... of good to a greater or a less good; and of evil to a greater or a less evil.
What is sense without relation? and relation, except to opposites?
What is beauty without relation to ugliness...
(This) is evident from their opposite relation.
